veranderings.voor: So het baie nedersettings naby water begin.
veranderings.na: So het baie nedersettings naby water ontstaan.
veranderings.rede: 'Ontstaan' is the natural Afrikaans verb for a settlement coming into being; 'begin' without an object reads flat.

veranderings.blok: Werk by die see en in die berge
veranderings.voor: Riviere en damme word ook vir hengel en watersport gebruik.
veranderings.na: Mense gebruik riviere en damme ook vir hengel en watersport.
veranderings.rede: An active sentence with a named subject is clearer for Grade 5 than the passive, and matches the active sentences around it.

vlae.blok: Die skakel werk albei kante toe
vlae.teks: Die skakel werk albei kante toe
vlae.rede: The block heading reads as a translation of 'the link works both ways'; 'skakel' is unusual here in Afrikaans and something like 'Dit werk albei kante toe' or 'Die verband werk albei kante toe' would be more natural. Flagged rather than changed because it is a heading.
